name: Cancelling an RTP - EPC v4 mock unhappy path scenario: rjcr_extra_field
description: An EPC response containing fields not declared in the OpenAPI spec is treated as an invalid message and is NOT tolerated for accept/reject purposes (confirmed with rtp-sender-v2 maintainers, PR #26). The extra `invalid-field` property invalidates the whole response, so the RJCR confirmation is not processed and the RTP stays in RFC_SENT.
